# Part One

## Seventeen

The bank in Napa closed on a Wednesday and the news reached the valley
the way weather does, from the west and all at once.

### The Morning

{--Nobody said the word.--} They said "the situation" and they said "for
now," and by evening they had stopped saying anything at all.

## Eighteen

Ferrante drove in on Thursday to see the building with his own eyes.
